sections.observations: Hero. Strongest area: video plus canvas over monolith and particle deer, clear H1, single orange CTA. Pill eyebrow and copy are left-aligned at ~170px gutter. Image and canvas animate on scroll (parallax). Mobile: deer sits directly behind eyebrow and body copy, reducing legibility of the grey paragraph. Pause button has cursor default.

sections.heading: Delivered
sections.observations: Delivered strip. Mono text, two items, 190px tall. Reads as a flat, plain text band with weak hierarchy; no logos, numbers or dividers. Generic.

sections.heading: What we build
sections.observations: What we build. Five uniform cards in a 3+2 grid with an empty sixth cell. AI integration card has a permanent red border as highlight. Cards themselves have no hover; only the h3 link gets a focus outline, no hover change. Static, generic SaaS card grid.

sections.heading: Built to be evaluated, not just demoed.
sections.observations: Evaluated band. Full-bleed network video/canvas with large H2, strong signature visual. Section is 1350px tall on desktop; section screenshot shows ~450px of empty dark space below the visual (pin/scroll runway). In full-page capture it leaves a large void. No CTA or proof inside.

sections.heading: How retrieval is built
sections.observations: How retrieval is built. Seven-node horizontal pipeline with particle canvas along the line. Nodes are empty circles with tiny mono labels; reads thin at 1440 with no stage descriptions. Mobile turns into vertical list. Mid-strength.

sections.heading: How an engagement runs
sections.observations: How an engagement runs. Desktop motion: horizontal pinned track of wide cards (1800px section); at rest only 2.5 cards visible, card 3 clipped at right edge, large empty area under cards and big dark gap before CTA in screenshots. Reduced motion: clean vertical stack of five full-width cards, but cards are mostly empty with one-line copy. Mobile: vertical stack.

sections.heading: Have something to build?
sections.observations: Final CTA. Glass card over network image with low-poly red deer; good closure. Orange CTA repeated. Deer art style differs from hero particle deer.
